FR-001.title: The application MUST propagate a non-absent process or lifecycle context from composition through every application-owned context-aware dependency.

FR-002.title: Request-triggered context-aware work MUST use the initiating request or application context through persistence, networking, and platform boundaries.

FR-003.title: Context-aware production APIs MUST reject an absent context rather than silently substitute an unrelated background context below an executable entry point.

FR-004.title: Every explicitly canceled application-owned context MUST be created with causal cancellation and canceled with a stable, non-empty semantic reason.

FR-005.title: Cleanup that must survive an already-canceled initiating context MUST preserve that context's values, apply the existing bounded cleanup duration, and expose the cleanup termination reason.

FR-006.title: Repeated or concurrent close paths MUST remain safe and MUST preserve the first applicable cancellation cause.

FR-007.title: Every affected Go test that needs a context MUST use the active test context as its root and derive values, cancellation, or deadlines from it.

context: area: main.go, app.go, and wails_host.go lifecycle composition
area: internal/player, internal/control, and internal/session context flow
area: internal/tunnel owned lifetimes and cleanup
constraint: context.WithCancelCause for explicitly canceled owned contexts
intent: Preserve application and request context end to end while making every owned cancellation reason observable.
expectations: No public wire, protobuf, persistence, or user-interface contract changes.
No new dependency or timeout-budget change.
approach: Require application/request contexts at ownership boundaries, thread them through the one durable coordinator seam, and replace manual cancellation with stable causal cancellation while keeping cleanup bounded and value-preserving.

decisions.decision: Create roots only at executable entry points
decisions.why: Lower layers must preserve caller cancellation and values

decisions.decision: Use causal cancellation for manually owned lifetimes
decisions.why: context.Cause makes shutdown and race outcomes diagnosable

decisions.decision: Detach only cancellation for bounded cleanup
decisions.why: Cleanup must survive cancellation without losing context values

decisions.decision: Add context only to the durable coordinator seam
decisions.why: Persistence needs operation ownership while pure in-memory transitions do not
decisions.rejected: Adding context to every coordinator method

decisions.decision: Treat player Start context as acquisition-only after listener commit
decisions.why: The constructor root owns the committed HTTP and ConnectRPC lifetime, so normal startup completion cannot disconnect players while pre-commit cancellation still aborts acquisition
decisions.rejected: Retaining context.AfterFunc from the bounded startup child into the committed server context

decisions.decision: Let http.Server.Shutdown solely own integration-listener teardown
decisions.why: Shutdown already closes the listener and a second required close produced a false teardown failure
decisions.rejected: Ignoring or special-casing net.ErrClosed from redundant listener cleanup
